The '''Halls of the Spirits''' was a memorial hall located in the capital city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. When [[Oln Rannar]] invited the [[Alliance Commander]] to the funeral proceedings of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Regalun Petryph]]'s cousins, [[Anosek]] and [[Anoser]], Rannar mentioned that their names would echo in the Halls of the Spirit.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=message|Your Presense is Requested|Oln Rannar}}</ref>
